user_query: entries in trass stories database with term uk

intent.goal: find entries containing 'uk' in Trass stories database

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.file_path,
u.file_size
FROM unified_content u
WHERE (
    u.database_name = 'stories'
    AND u.workspace IN ('trass')
    AND (
        LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%uk%'
        OR LOWER(u.file_path) LIKE '%uk%'
    )
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
